verdict.rationale: Sentry publishes a self-serve pricing page listing plan tiers and what each includes, such as a Free plan covering Error Monitoring and Tracing. That points to some published, sales-free pricing, but the evidence shows no per-signal rates or quotas from which an SRE could forecast spend. missing for 10: published per-signal unit prices (errors, spans, logs, replays), volume quotas or overage rates, a cost calculator or estimation guidance, and independent confirmation that costs are predictable without contacting sales.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can predict costs from transparent published per-signal pricing without talking to sales

citations.quote: For solo devs working on small projects... One user, Error Monitoring and Tracing, Alerts and notifications via email, 10 custom dashboards, MCP access
